title: agropyron missuricum
intro: Agropyron missuricum, commonly known as Missoula bluegrass, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Chinese medicine. Missoula bluegrass is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and rheumatism, due to its health benefits of anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties. Its therapeutic actions include relieving respiratory issues and reducing inflammation, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides.
